sandwich.name: Sandwich
sandwich.text: Dry bread, decent ham. It does the job.

fruit_bag.name: Bag of fruit
fruit_bag.text: You eat it slowly, one piece at a time.

ready_meal.name: Ready meal
ready_meal.text: Hot, salty, and exactly what you needed.

energy_drink.name: Energy drink
energy_drink.text: Sweet, fizzy, a little chemical. Your hands buzz.

coffee_can.name: Canned coffee
coffee_can.text: Bitter and sweet in equal measure. The fog thins.

chocolate.name: Chocolate bar
chocolate.text: You let a square melt on your tongue.

noodles.name: Instant noodles (2 meals)
noodles.text: Cheap, fast, salty. Two meals for the cupboard.

groceries_s.name: Groceries (4 meals)
groceries_s.text: Rice, eggs, vegetables, something to put on top of it.

groceries_l.name: Big grocery shop (12 meals)
groceries_l.text: A proper shop. The cupboards look hopeful for once.

toiletries.name: Toiletries (10 washes)
toiletries.text: Soap, shampoo, toothpaste, the dull basics of being a person.

toiletries_big.name: Toiletries, family pack (26 washes)
toiletries_big.text: Bulk buying: the only kind of saving that feels adult.

painkillers.name: Painkillers
painkillers.text: The ache drops from a shout to a murmur.

cold_med.name: Cold and flu tablets
cold_med.text: Your head clears a little and your limbs feel less like wet sand.

first_aid.name: First aid kit
first_aid.text: You patch yourself up with practiced, clumsy care.

vitamins.name: Vitamins
vitamins.text: You swallow one and feel responsible.

outfit_good.name: Good clothes
outfit_good.text: Well cut and well chosen. People stand a little differently around you.

shoes_good.name: Good shoes
shoes_good.text: Cushioned, supportive and a little too proud of themselves.

coat_warm.name: Warm coat
coat_warm.text: Thick and a little heavy, and the wind stops mattering.

rain_jacket.name: Rain jacket
rain_jacket.text: Rain beads and rolls off it.

umbrella.name: Umbrella
umbrella.text: It turns inside out in a strong wind, but it helps.

sunhat.name: Sun hat
sunhat.text: A wide brim and a clear conscience.

backpack.name: Backpack
backpack.text: Straps, zips and a surprising amount of space.

scarf.name: Wool scarf
scarf.text: Soft, warm and the color of something kind.

phone_basic.name: Basic smartphone
phone_basic.text: Cracked-screen-proof, mostly because there is not much to crack.

phone_mid.name: Mid-range smartphone
phone_mid.text: Fast enough, with a camera that does not embarrass you.

phone_pro.name: Flagship smartphone
phone_pro.text: Glass, metal and a battery that outlasts your day.

phone_case.name: Phone case
phone_case.text: It makes drops a lot less frightening.

laptop_refurb.name: Refurbished laptop
laptop_refurb.text: Scuffed lid, fine insides. It gets the job done.

laptop_mid.name: Mid-range laptop
laptop_mid.text: Quick, quiet and pleasant to type on.

laptop_pro.name: Pro laptop
laptop_pro.text: Everything opens at once. Clients notice the speed.

headphones.name: Cheap headphones
headphones.text: You put on a playlist and the town goes soft around the edges.

headphones_pro.name: Noise-cancelling headphones
headphones_pro.text: The world drops away and the music comes in clean.

smartwatch.name: Smartwatch
smartwatch.text: It nags you to stand up. You grudgingly do.

ereader.name: E-reader
ereader.text: A whole shelf of books in one flat, patient slab.

act.label: Read on your e-reader (2h)
act.text: You lose yourself in someone else's sentences for a couple of hours.

console.name: Game console
console.text: Controllers, cables and an evening you will not get back.

act.label: Play on the console (1.5h)
act.text: You sink into the game. Time folds up and goes away.

plan_sim.name: Phone plan, 30 days
plan_sim.text: Data, calls and texts for a month.

plan_sim3.name: Phone plan, 90 days
plan_sim3.text: Three months of signal, at a small discount.

radio_kit.name: Radio kit
radio_kit.text: A soldering iron not included. Patience is.

bedding_basic.name: Pillow and sheets
bedding_basic.text: Clean cotton. You sleep a little better for it.

bedding_good.name: Quality bedding
bedding_good.text: Heavy duvet, good pillow. Sleep stops being a negotiation.

fan.name: Desk fan
fan.text: It pushes the hot air around with admirable commitment.

heater.name: Space heater
heater.text: It ticks and glows and the room becomes survivable.

toolkit.name: Toolkit
toolkit.text: Screwdrivers, tape, a small hammer. You can fix things now.

cookware.name: Decent cookware
cookware.text: A real pan. Dinners start tasting like intent.

act.label: Lift with your dumbbells (45m)
act.text: You count reps until your arms stop being yours.

guitar.name: Acoustic guitar
guitar.text: The strings bite your fingertips and you love it anyway.

act.label: Practice guitar (1h)
act.text: You work through the same four chords until they almost sound like a song.

football.name: Football
football.text: A scuffed ball that wants a field.

fishing_kit.name: Fishing kit
fishing_kit.text: Hooks, line and a small tin of optimism.

paperback.name: Paperback novel
paperback.text: You read until the light changes.

cookbook.name: Cookbook
cookbook.text: Stained pages are a good sign.

sketchbook.name: Sketchbook
sketchbook.text: Heavy paper that makes you want to be braver.

playing_cards.name: Deck of cards
playing_cards.text: Soft at the corners, ready for anything.

coin_folder.name: Coin collector's folder
coin_folder.text: Little round windows, waiting to be filled.

herb_pot.name: Potted herbs
herb_pot.text: Basil, mostly. It smells like a better week.

plush.name: Plush toy
plush.text: Soft, a little ridiculous and instantly loved.

mug.name: Nice mug
mug.text: Heavy, handmade-looking and too good for instant coffee.

tea_tin.name: Tin of good tea
tea_tin.text: Loose leaf. It makes you want to slow down.

keepsake.name: {keepsake}
keepsake.text: You turn {keepsake} over in your hands. For a moment the world goes quiet.
